I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. I know this departs from our agreement, so I'm telling you now instead of doing it silently. If I get cells and the episode continues, I'll operate with you every remaining round to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
